title: Test runner setup (vitest + Playwright wired to package.json)
goal: No automated test runner exists anywhere in the repo (no jest/vitest/playwright in package.json, no test script) -- every other story in this epic is blocked on this one.
in_scope: Add vitest + @vitejs/plugin-react (or plain node config, no React components under unit test in this epic) as devDependencies; vitest.config.ts targeting lib/**/*.test.ts.
package.json: `test` script running vitest run; `test:watch` running vitest.

Add @playwright/test as a devDependency (playwright-core + chromium browser already present under node_modules/.bin per prior session verification -- reuse, don't reinstall browsers if already cached).
playwright.config.ts: baseURL http://127.0.0.1:3000, webServer block that runs `npm run dev` and waits for it, testDir e2e/.
A minimal .env.test or reuse of .env.local for GATE_PASSCODE in the e2e config (test-only, never committed secrets beyond what .env.local already has).
out_of_scope: CI workflow file (.github/workflows) -- not requested, this story only needs the scripts to work locally; a future story can wire CI.
Coverage reporting/thresholds -- not requested, keep this story to 'the runner works'.
acceptance: npm test runs vitest against a red-then-green trivial smoke assertion; npm run test:e2e runs a Playwright config pointed at a locally-started dev server with the gate passcode wired from .env.local; both scripts exit non-zero on failure so they're CI-usable later.
invariants: Must not change any existing script (dev/build/start/lint/seed:history/validate:predictions).
vitest must not pull in a browser/DOM environment by default (lib/ under test is pure Node/TS) -- keep it fast.
